adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an `addMembers` action in `admin-group.js.es6` that calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))` but explicitly does not clear the input (`// TODO: should clear the input`) and never resets `usernames` on success. This means clicking “Add” again will resend the same usernames value. Additionally, `Discourse.Group#addMembers` and `#removeMember` in `discourse/models/group.js` only attach a `.then(...)` handler and do not handle rejection locally, so failures from the `/admin/groups/:id/members.json` requests are not surfaced/handled here.
